#: DOFs of the closure test of doc/MisalignmentTest.md, example (b): the 6 rigid-body DOFs of the ITS layer 3 half barrel 0 and of ALL its 12 staves (only 2 of them are misaligned by misalign_ITS_L3HB0.json), the mean vertex free. Everything else is fixed and defines the frame. The staves have to be all free: the automatic mean-of-children constraint of the half barrel would otherwise force the mean of just the free ones to 0, biasing the result.
